title: Open source PoolTool.io and sustain for 1 year

ms.promise:
Three deliverables:
・Three open source github repositories will be created with initial commits of all source code. A) PoolTool app (ios/android) B) PoolTool Website (vue) C) PoolTool Backend (mostly python)
・Ads will be removed from the website
・PoolTool will be operational
ms.criteria:
・Do we have 3 repositories with source code.
・Have ads been removed from pooltool when you are not logged in
・Is the pooltool.io website operational
ms.report:
Hello, Milestone 1 is complete. Here is the evidence as per our milestone completion list. 
1) Links to repositories
Here are the links to the repositories:
https://github.com/PoolTool-io/PoolToolBackend-DB
https://github.com/PoolTool-io/PoolToolBackend-CNODE
https://github.com/PoolTool-io/CardanoStakeholderAuthenticator
https://github.com/PoolTool-io/PoolToolWebsite
https://github.com/PoolTool-io/PoolToolMobileApp
We ended up breaking it into 5 repositories instead of 3.
2) 10 to 15 second video showing ads removed. (see video link here)
https://somup.com/c0Xjr9gIGa 
3) pooltool website operational. (see link to monitoring website here)
https://stats.uptimerobot.com/GJzyBtWA4K

ms.criteria:
As per dialog with the milestone reviewer we decided to do 5 milestones instead of 12 as in the original proposal to reduce reviewing workload. 
The proposal does not commit to any type of specific monitoring strategy but in discussions with the milestone reviewers we came up with a strategy to do a free uptime service tool to monitor status continuously.
https://stats.uptimerobot.com/GJzyBtWA4K
